name: Geoff Patterson
story: Geoff Patterson developed ARDS in dBase II in 1987 and, with Duncan Cunningham, BIOSITE using Oracle in 1993.
Geoff Patterson developed the Amphibian and Reptile Distribution Scheme in dBase II in 1987, when responsibility for it passed to DOC.
